comparison.objective: Carry a ball tray, versus commission a compact industrial shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Stable tray transport and spill prevention versus fine hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar adjustment, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Tray delivery without losing balls is title-implied; no body/specs or thresholds are supplied. Candidate measures dynamic stopping and post-lock drift.
comparison.reason: Stable transport is a different tested ability from mechanical tuning and iterative impact-response assessment.
